title: Leonardo da Vinci (1452–1519) — Verrocchio's Workshop, Mirror-Script Dissections, Unfinished Masterpieces, and the Sforza Bronze Horse

teenKit.tldr: Leonardo da Vinci wasn't a serene wizard, but a chaotic dropout whose inability to finish projects masked one of history's most relentless observational machines. Behind the masterpieces lay thousands of unpublished notes on anatomy, engineering, and optical physics that were centuries ahead of their time.
teenKit.whyItMatters: Understanding Leonardo proves that a messy, non-linear brain prone to distraction and obsessive deep dives is a feature, not a bug, of true creative innovation.
keyTakeaways: Born an illegitimate child and locked out of elite Latin universities, Leonardo was forced to learn entirely through direct observation and drawing rather than book-learning.
He pitched himself to Milan's warlord primarily as a military engineer, treating his painting skills as an afterthought to secure funding for his wild inventions.
His secret candlelit autopsies and glass heart models allowed him to discover fluid mechanics and coronary mechanics that medical science only validated 450 years later.

vocab.meaning: Leonardo's signature writing style where he wrote backward from right to left, requiring a mirror to read easily.
A doomed, massive seventy-ton clay horse sculpture commissioned by Ludovico Sforza that was never cast in bronze.
The buildup of fatty plaques inside artery walls, which Leonardo accurately sketched from human dissections long before modern cardiology.
Born to parents who were not married to each other, a legal status in Renaissance Florence that barred Leonardo from formal university education.

quiz.question: How did Leonardo da Vinci primarily market himself when he moved to Milan to work for warlord Ludovico Sforza?
options: As a master portrait painter and decorator
As a military engineer and weapons designer
As a classical scholar and Latin translator
As an expert architect for religious cathedrals
quiz.explanation: Leonardo famously pitched himself as a military engineer in a ten-point letter, tacking painting onto the very bottom as an afterthought.

quiz.question: Why was Leonardo excluded from attending formal universities in Florence?
options: He failed his entrance exams in mathematics
He was an illegitimate child born to a peasant mother
His family could not afford the basic cost of paper
He was exiled from the city at a very young age
quiz.explanation: As the illegitimate son of a notary and a peasant orphan, social class rules completely locked him out of Latin university schooling.

quiz.question: What is unique about the thousands of notebook pages Leonardo left behind?
options: They were written entirely in Latin code
They were published as best-selling books during his lifetime
They were written in reverse mirror-script
They contained only mathematical equations with no drawings
quiz.explanation: Leonardo jotted down his ideas, anatomical drawings, and inventions using a right-to-left mirror-script that had to be read in a reflection.
